Title: Public preview: Add-on and node image in AKS release tracker

Body.Content:
AKS release tracker updates are now available in public preview. This  release adds specific page for node image regional release progress and release notes. AKS users will get more accurate information about specific node images with the release trackers as the node image updates are decoupled from AKS.

Learn more.
